grade.name: Form 1
grade.phase: Secondary — the source scheme itself uses "Form 1" for this level under the 2023 CBC.

topics.name: HOME TRADE
topics.description: This topic exposes learners to the real world of conducting business within the country. Home trade is trade done within a country and is divided into retail and wholesale trade.

sub_topics.name: RETAIL TRADE
sub_topics.description: This sub-topic covers what retail trade is, its functions, factors considered before putting up a retail outlet, opportunities and challenges of running a retail business, and how learners can practice running a retail business.

sub_topics.name: WHOLESALE TRADE
sub_topics.description: This sub-topic covers the definition of wholesale trade, its functions, its opportunities and challenges, and how learners can practice running a wholesale business.

sub_topics.name: DOCUMENTS USED IN HOME TRADE
sub_topics.description: This sub-topic covers the written business documentation involved between buyers and sellers to provide evidence of transactions, protect rights, and ensure legal compliance.

competencies.description: Prepare documents used in home trade
